items.title: Barry Harris — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think he died in 1955, or ‘56. ... Clifford Brown and Richie Powell got killed in a car accident ... So that left Max and George Morrow, the bass player. So Donald Byrd, Sonny Rollins and myself, we joined Max’s band.

ctx.x: What kind of person was she to work for?

Ruth Brown? Very nice. You know, and then there were a lot of older musicians, who were good musicians, you know. Abe Woodley, I mean I can name names, you know. I can see faces probably more than name names, you know. Um, I can remember a cat telling me, “Barry, you need to learn how to play I Got Rhythm.” This must have been really early on – or maybe not – a tenor player – I say, “well what do you mean?” He said, “you’re playing two choruses of the blues, and then the Rhythm bridge, then a chorus of the blues.…
Now, what year was that, again? ’52?
